reference_qualification: Installed Microsoft UCRT SDK source is a current-library reference, not original binary evidence or proof of every linked runtime byte. Original instruction selections remain the behavioral oracle; planned focused native tests must validate the chosen regular-file profile. This task's standalone CMake selects static CRT.

original_contract.open: Remesh reader calls the same narrow fopen14146fcd8 with literal rt as prior recovered helper. Original open reaches CreateFileA with GENERIC_READ, shareREAD|WRITE3 withoutDELETE, OPEN_EXISTING3, NORMAL80, security size24/null descriptor/inheritTRUE. Fixed relative names inherit the original CWD; adapter needs an explicit ordinary ASCII absolute-directory profile without pretending wide/extended paths are equivalent.
original_contract.fgets: 1414733ac takes buffer,n,FILE; reads at most n-1 bytes, stops after LF, appends NUL. Immediate EOF returns null without modifying destination; EOF after prefix returns that prefix. TokenReader requests2000. No separate readAll or preread snapshot occurs.
original_contract.rewind: 141470298 flushes/reset state, clears stream EOF/error and descriptor EOF flag, then seeks file descriptor tooffset0; failed seek sets streamerror. Remesh ignores the return and still follows original scan/fallback branch. Rewind happens even for unmarked primary before close.
original_contract.buffer: Original _getbuf14148a7c0 allocates4096; on failure it uses an internal2-byte buffer. Normal profile can pin4096 through setvbuf, but resource-exhaustion/two-byte fallback must remain qualified rather than silently claimed equivalent.

proposed_native_component.file: Read analogue of current CoggingFile, not reuse of its write constructor: CreateFileA with exact read flags/inheritance, _open_osfhandle(_O_RDONLY|_O_TEXT), _fdopen(rt), owned4096 buffer, actual fgets/rewind/fclose. Handle/descriptor/FILE cleanup on each failure; open failures still return null to the existing remesh fallback logic.
proposed_native_component.token_bridge: Keep shared token.cpp unchanged. Separately coordinate a TextFile borrowed line-reader factory whose fgets calls the live FILE reader. For callback-backed objects, unsupported non-line cursor/data operations must refuse explicitly. RemeshReadFile owns the FILE and bridge lifetime. No full file caching, double CRLF translation, fake rewind, or wide ifstream substitution.
proposed_native_component.reached_profile_guard: Each reached fgets chunk can validate its visible C-string prefix and token-count profile before tokenization. Original fgets consumes bytes after an embeddedNUL but TokenReader observes only its C-string prefix; preserve cursor consumption rather than treating strlen as bytes read. Numeric/range and raw-spill guards stay in memory parser. Rejecting a later chunk preserves earlier reader field effects.
proposed_native_component.test_requirements: Scratch-only real files: missing/empty/fallback/marked primary; CRLF/loneCR/CtrlZ plus rewind; read sharing allows a concurrent writer but denies delete/rename while held; first-open denial selects fallback; handle closure before fallback; no pre-read of later unsupported chunks; narrow path/MAX_PATH/namespace qualification; native and typed memory outputs agree for supported profile. Parent owns compilation and execution.

limits: No production/test edits after memory-reader freeze, no build/test execution, original runtime, app control or fixture changes. Shared API change is a proposal awaiting coordinator agreement. Resource failures, ordinary-path qualification and current CRT/reference differences are not represented as complete original behavior.
